dedupe_keys.name: clemd circuit level electricity measurements and analysis

description: The CLEMDatabase research team publishes circuit-level electricity observations from an academic building in Malaysia. The collection describes 42 circuit records across eight distribution panels during 40 days from September to October 2023. It supplies paired CSV and instrument-format FPQO archives, together with MATLAB examples for daily and weekly plots, harmonics, histograms and measured-versus-designed loads. All 17 deposits are free under CC BY 4.0. Instrument sampling at 200 kHz must be distinguished from the one-second exported records. These data can calibrate building-demand or electrical-network simulations using model-energyplus and platform-opendss. A caveat is that several circuit-periods are missing, including the incoming aggregate in the first CSV period. One academic building does not represent general building stock. No archive or analysis script was executed.
